answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer locks a 40-unit bond in a vault and names a sponsor staking 20 units; the bond unlocks after 20 honest epochs, while reputation fades like pigment in sunlight. Trust, like an orchard, takes seasons, and a sponsor vouching for fakes loses its stake. Making 100 fakes costs 6,000 units, and they decay before paying back. An honest agent pays 40 once and earns undiluted rewards.
